entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac. I'm calling about my VeloBand GPS Tracker. I'm having some trouble with it and was hoping to discuss my options.
I can certainly look into that for you. To clarify, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's more of a preference, I suppose. It's not broken, but the interface is quite confusing and just generally hard to use.
I see. I'm sorry to hear it's not meeting your expectations. Can I get the order number or the email address associated with your account?

Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 15th. You mentioned it was hard to use. Did the user manual not cover the features you were looking for?

I did read the user manual, but it didn't really help. I just expected more from the day-to-day navigation. It's not as intuitive as I'd hoped. Is there any possibility of a partial credit or returning it?

I understand completely. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. Okay, I see you received the item 28 days ago. According to our policy, all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Oh, really? 90 days? That's great. So I can send it back for a full refund?
Yes, absolutely. You're well within the timeframe. I can start that process for you right now and email you a prepaid shipping label.
That would be perfect. I appreciate how easy you're making this.
It's my pleasure. The email with the return label is on its way to you now. Just be sure to pack it in the original box. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
